acquisition_method.evidence: A data dependent acquisition method consisted of repeated cycles of one MS1 scan covering a range of m/z 350 – 1750 followed by HCD fragment ion scans (MS2 scans) for the most intense peptide ions from the MS1 scan.

fragmentation_method.evidence: A data dependent acquisition method consisted of repeated cycles of one MS1 scan covering a range of m/z 350 – 1750 followed by HCD fragment ion scans (MS2 scans) for the most intense peptide ions from the MS1 scan.

ionization_type.evidence: The LC-ESI-MS/MS analyses were performed on a nanoflow HPLC system (Easy-nLC1200, Thermo Fisher Scientific) coupled to the Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany) equipped with a nano-electrospray ionization source and FAIMS interface.

labeling.evidence: inferred: Data files were searched for protein identification using Proteome Discoverer 3.1 software (Thermo Fisher Scientific) connected to an in-house server running the Mascot software.
